details:
Current Problem:

The official featured/pinned popular world slot is permanently locked to one single map for weeks or even months.

This creates multiple negative experiences:

1. New players only see the same map every time they open the game, missing out on many other high-quality, popular community worlds.

2. The permanently featured world becomes extremely overcrowded, causing lag, performance drops, and long loading times for everyone who joins.

3. Talented world creators cannot get exposure for their popular maps, as the featured spot never cycles.

4. Regular players get bored seeing the same pinned map every day with no variety.

Feature Request:

Add an automatic rotation system for the official featured popular world slot:

1. Cycle a selection of high-popularity, well-rated community worlds on a fixed schedule (e.g., every 24 / 48 / 72 hours).

2. Keep the original featured slot UI, just swap out the map on rotation timers.

3. Prioritize worlds with stable player counts, positive user ratings, and active creators for the rotation pool.

4. Keep seasonal/event worlds in the rotation pool during their active periods.

Benefits for VRChat & Players:

1. Distribute player traffic across multiple popular worlds to reduce overcrowding and lag.

2. Give more world creators fair visibility to grow their audiences.

3. Offer daily variety for returning players, improving long-term engagement.

4. Help new users discover more types of VRChat environments instead of only one fixed map.

5. No heavy performance or backend cost; only a simple timed content swap for the featured UI panel.
title: Rotate Featured Popular Worlds Instead of Locking on a Single One
